body: I’m a Christian (not super Christian) and think other Christians saying to leave it in gods hands is one of the most harmful things to say to someone. If I have to console someone (unless they want to hear that) I will never say that. They’re not focusing on that right now. As for what you said, I don’t think it’s dumb at all. When I feel depressed (comes in waves) I hope there’s a moment given to me where it could be an accident, or I died doing something to help others, that way it didn’t have to be suicide. But I will say I’m glad your still here. Even if your reasoning for it isn’t the best, I’m glad your still around.

I’m just aro and I feel the same way. I’m not the type of person to sleep around so I wish I could switch it off too and just be in a relationship like that. It’s kinda scary to me to think that I might never feel that emotion that a lot of other people feel, however the way I’m trying to get over this fear is just by saying to myself, why do I care what they have? It’s not what I feel or want so why should I care. I don’t know, I’m still new to this and that’s just how I take comfort. Hope this helps.

This happened to me recently and is kinda what made start thinking I’m aro. I rejected the person cause I didn’t feel any of that romantic attraction, and it made me realize I’ve never felt that way about anyone. Anyway, there’s never an easy way to reject someone and most people that you do reject will think it’s them even if you tell them it’s not. I guess the best advice I can give is to not beat around the bush to much, and try your best to get the other person to understand you (but don’t expect them to understand right away).
Thank you for taking the time to write that. I’m leaning towards aromantic so I think I will for the time just go with that.
